hazard: Lack of rolling risk assessment documentation in SystemOne

reports.title: Jai Singh: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: Matters of Concern: The absence of ongoing risk assessment documentation for patients with mental illness within SystmOne records at HMP Birmingham.
promises.summary: Implement ongoing risk assessment documentation in SystmOne for mental health patients at HMP Birmingham.

promises.quote: The Trust has begun a 3 month pilot which will ensure a Consultant [name redacted] attends the 3 MDT meetings at the Prison each week. The Secure Care and Offender Health Clinical Governance Committee (CGC) will review the outcomes for the pilot after 3 months, to ascertain if this is clinically beneficial to patients
promises.summary: Pilot with consultant psychiatrist in MDT, review after 3 months

concerns.quote: A multitude of factors contributed to Mr. [name redacted] death across the custodial and healthcare teams within HMP Birmingham. Many steps have been taken by all organisations with responsibility for Mr. [name redacted] safety and health during his time at HMP Birmingham to rectify failings that have been identified such as the consistent failure to use interpreters, poor communication and record keeping within and between teams, the absence of meaningful engagement with Mr. [name redacted] family, insufficient
concerns.hazard: failure to use interpreters poor communication and record keeping insufficient engagement with family insufficient use A

concerns.quote: the mental health team multi-disciplinary team (MDT) does not include a psychiatrist; and ii. the absence of any ongoing risk assessment documentation for patients with mental illness within the SystemOne records at HMP Birmingham
concerns.hazard: absence of psychiatrist in mental health MDT and lack of ongoing risk assessment documentation

concerns.quote: Other electronic health care records systems used in mental health settings have a rolling risk assessment document that clinicians are required to review and update at certain points in a patient's management. The risk assessment document provides a prompt to clinicians to formally consider risk and come to a reasoned, documented conclusion that then feeds into decision making. The record also provides a reliable, easily accessible source of risk history. No such facility is in use on SystemOne
concerns.hazard: lack of rolling risk assessment documentation in SystemOne

reports.title: Paula Lenihan: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

concerns.quote: in addition to this present case, where the deceased's risk assessment was not updated between November 2021 and her death in March 2023 despite circumstances which I was told ought to have triggered an update, there were a further number of cases within the Trust in which Root Cause Analysis reports had been produced, where it had also been found that risk assessments were not being completed in line with expectations; further, that it was not clear why this was happening

If risk assessments are not being properly completed or updated, then there is an obvious risk of deaths occurring in the future, as a result of insufficient recording of risk. The fact that risk-relevant information may be recorded in the body of clinical notes is not reassuring, because a risk assessment or risk summary ought to capture the most salient risk information so that a professional looking quickly can absorb it; this is all the more important where professionals are under time

In my opinion action needs to be taken to prevent the occurrence or continuance of the issue within the trust around the insufficient recording or updating of risk assessments, or to eliminate or reduce the risk of death created by such circumstances
concerns.hazard: insufficient recording or updating of risk assessments

links.explanation: Both reports highlight problems with the completion and updating of risk assessments in mental health care, noting that inadequate documentation increases risk of harm.
